summary: Manual retrospective annotation of the seaside route mistake, correction, shared drawing and anemone observation. Distinguishes physical landmarks, mistaken labels, map representations, imagined plans and the final sketch.

ambiguities.issue: The initially desired pool is nonspecific e69; the actual destination pool is e46. Goal satisfaction does not force identity of a hypothetical witness.
Milo recognizes Captain; later anemone uses the same discourse ID with attributed identification, not biological proof of individual identity since last summer.
Twin Chimneys at the mistaken turn names the bathhouse pair e17; correct landmark is e8. The belief’s intended landmark remains separate from its perceived wrong referent.
Map marks and final sketch entities are distinct from their referents; representation links are recorded explicitly.
Milo’s collective wrong-route report ev143 is the shared episode containing Tessa’s leading ev86 and Milo’s following ev46, not another walk.
No path drawn on map does not prove no physical passage. Shore passage exists but shrinks; the scramble is never performed.
Route-flanking rocks and view-gap rocks have separate IDs because exact overlap is unknown.
Wall offers a basket resting place, but actual basket placement and picnic-cloth deployment are not narrated. No invented placing/unpacking event.
Two is a local clock time with no stated meridiem; timely return is promised but never shown.
Not sounding cross does not prove absence of anger; Tessa’s look is uninterpreted. Grinning and laughing are explicit behaviors, not permanent personality labels.

feature_gaps.decision: Proposed typed surface/object support capacity, distinct from actual spatial_support, bodily sitting and containment. The wall can support the basket, but placement is unobserved.

Reused reference_metonymic_link with relation=depicts/maps_traveled_route. Its definition supports literal-to-related-referent links, but future schema may benefit from an explicit representation subtype distinguishing carrier, image entity and world referent.
Reused event_collective_participants with member leading/following event IDs. A declared event-part/subevent convention would make this relationship less ad hoc.

prompt_feedback: Include a mistaken landmark example where speaker_local_name differs from actual entity identity; later correction must not rewrite the earlier mistaken belief into fact.
Distinguish fictional enactment from map/sketch depiction; provide a standard carrier/image/referent bridge rather than forcing image objects into physical identity.
A static path winding or slipping inland is fictive motion; it must not create a person walking that path.
Negative evidence from a map is representation-scoped. An unmarked route can still physically exist.
Use clear episode/subevent conventions when a collective retrospective report summarizes distinct leader/follower actions.
Qualitative a second can mean briefly rather than an exactly measured one-second duration.
coverage_notes: All 806 words have manually selected contextual POS and lemma; every one of 32 paragraphs reviewed. Sparse supported grammar, reference, event, physical, mental, discourse and narrative fields use the full catalog as available, without feature quotas. Quoted and imagined propositions preserve local truth conditions. No API calls or causal filtering.
not_claimed: a literal flowering plant instead of an anemone
